recipe.name: Vegetable Pasta
recipe.description: A delicious, vibrant homemade vegetable pasta tossed in fresh tomato garlic sauce with Italian herbs.

ingredients.ingredient: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
Fresh basil leaves and Parmesan for garnish

instructions.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook the pasta until al dente (approx. 9-11 minutes).
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium flame and sauté minced garlic until aromatic.
Add sliced bell peppers and zucchini; cook for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer on low heat for 8 minutes into a rich sauce.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup of starchy pasta water. Toss pasta into the skillet, adding pasta water if needed.
Garnish with freshly torn basil and grated cheese. Serve steaming hot.

recipe.name: Decadent Chocolate Cake
recipe.description: Rich, moist, and deeply chocolatey fudge cake topped with a silky dark chocolate ganache glaze.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 cup Dark Chocolate Chips for ganache

instructions.step: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 9-inch round baking pans.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla extract. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes until smooth.
Stir in boiling hot coffee by hand (batter will be thin, which creates moisture).
Pour evenly into pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool completely, stack layers with chocolate ganache frosting, slice, and savor.

recipe.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipe.description: Creamy and mildly sweet cottage cheese cubes gently simmered in a luscious butter-tomato-cashew gravy.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 tsp Kasuri Methi (crushed dried fenugreek leaves)

instructions.step: Boil tomatoes with soaked cashews for 10 minutes until skins crack. Cool and blend into a silky smooth purée.
Heat butter and oil in a heavy kadai. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute.
Pour the strained tomato-cashew purée and cook until oil starts separating from the masala.
Add chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric, salt, and a pinch of sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Gently slide in the fresh paneer cubes and simmer on low flame for 3 minutes without overcooking.
Swirl in fresh cream and crushed kasuri methi. Serve piping hot with garlic naan or basmati rice.

recipe.name: Crispy Vegetable Sandwich
recipe.description: A crunchy, wholesome toasted multi-grain sandwich layered with fresh garden vegetables and tangy mint chutney.

ingredients.ingredient: 4 slices Whole Wheat or Multi-Grain Bread

instructions.step: Spread soft butter generously on one side of each bread slice, followed by green mint chutney.
Layer boiled potato slices on the bread, seasoning with a sprinkle of chaat masala and salt.
Add cucumber slices, tomato slices, and onion rings. Top with cheese if desired.
Close with the second slice of bread and lightly butter the outer sides.
Grill or toast in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown and super crispy on both sides.
Cut diagonally into triangles and serve immediately with tomato ketchup.

recipe.name: Creamy Banana Honey Smoothie
recipe.description: An energizing, nutrient-dense breakfast smoothie prepared with ripe bananas, Greek yogurt, honey, and chia seeds.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 cup Chilled Almond Milk or Whole Milk
1.5 tbsp Pure Honey or Maple Syrup
1 tbsp Peanut Butter or Almond Butter

instructions.step: Peel and slice bananas into chunks.
Place banana slices, chilled milk, and Greek yogurt into a high-speed blender jar.
Add peanut butter, pure honey, chia seeds, and cinnamon powder.
Add ice cubes and blend on high speed for 60-90 seconds until silky smooth and creamy.
Pour into tall chilled glasses, dust with cinnamon, and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
recipe.description: A nourishing power bowl featuring fluffy quinoa, crisp cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, and feta cheese.

instructions.step: Rinse quinoa under cold water. Combine quinoa and vegetable broth in a pot, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and let sit covered for 5 minutes; fluff gently with a fork and cool to room temperature.
In a small jar, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
In a large salad bowl, combine cooled quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, olives, and fresh parsley.
Pour dressing over the bowl and toss lightly to combine.
Top with crumbled feta cheese and a lemon wedge. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
